meta.name: MoneyPrinterTurbo AI Video Materials
meta.description: Batch-generate short video material clips without subtitles or voice-over for MoneyPrinterTurbo.
meta.inputSummary: Scene description, aspect ratio and scene number

steps.instruction: Generate standalone video material clips usable for short-video editing. Do not generate subtitles, text, titles, watermarks, logos or narration audio. Keep subject movement and camera movement natural, and avoid sudden cuts.

instructions: Each row generates one standalone MP4 video material clip.
The scene number keeps multiple materials on the same topic visually distinct in their shots.

fields.label: Scene description
fields.description: The video visuals, subject, action and camera requirements to generate

presentation.placeholder: e.g. office workers using an AI assistant in a modern office, natural light, slow push-in shot

fields.label: Aspect ratio
fields.description: The aspect ratio used by the final MoneyPrinterTurbo video

fields.label: Scene number
fields.description: Scene index within the same batch, starting from 1

values.scenePrompt: Office workers using an AI assistant in a modern office, natural light, slow push-in shot, no text, no watermark
